hints.title: Element-Wise Mapping
hints.text: Authoring a custom array transformation requires taking each element and returning a new array populated with the transformed values.

hints.title: Passing Element and Index
hints.text: The transformer callback takes two arguments: the element itself and its zero-based index. Pass both arr[i] and i on every iteration.

hints.title: Preallocated Transformation Loop
hints.text: Preallocate result = new Array(arr.length). For i from 0 to arr.length - 1, assign result[i] = fn(arr[i], i). Return result.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Executes transformation callback exactly once per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Built-in Array.prototype.map is disallowed by problem constraints requiring fundamental implementation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Preallocating array capacity avoids dynamic reallocation overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Supplying both element and index arguments to the transformation callback.
